thread.title: Apple ( AAPL ) readers might have read I predicted last Frid

author: Motek Moyen
title: Apple ( AAPL ) readers might have read I predicted last Frid
text:
Apple ( AAPL ) readers might have read I predicted last Friday that Samsung ( OTC:SSNLF ) can sell 30 million units of the new Galaxy S9/S9+ smartphones. The primary reason for that hypothesis was the estimated 33 million units of Galaxy S8 and Note 8 that were sold last year. I now propose that the new Samsung flagship phones can feasibly sell 40 million units before 2018 ends. 
The potential impact to Apple it that it might sell 10 million fewer units (my guesstimate) of the iPhone X this year. It could lead to Apple not getting an extra $9.99 billion more in FY 2018 iPhone revenue. The iPhone X has been Apple’s best-selling flagship phone since its November 2017 release. Canalyst estimated that Apple shipped 29 million iPhone X units last Q4. Seven million of them to the U.S. 
The iPhone X accounted for a large part of the 77.3 million iPhones that Apple sold in Q1 2018 business cycle. 

(Source: Canalys) 
The first day of Mobile World Congress 2018 revealed that Samsung will sell the unlocked U.S. version of Galaxy S9 for just $719.99 , and the Galaxy S9+ for $839.99. The Galaxy S9+ is notably more affordable than the iPhone X, which starts at $999. The newer Galaxy S9+ (not the old Galaxy Note 8) is also obviously Samsung’s top rival offering to the iPhone X.
